processing: UTF-8 shapefile projected from Web Mercator to WGS84; negative longitudes unwrapped east of 180 degrees; paired source cuts on Chukotka and Wrangel Island aligned at 180 degrees and dissolved; shared source topology dissolved into 15 republics. No modern-country boundary substitution. Regional GIS population aggregates are not used for republic totals.
